units.source_text: 千重子拎着大菜篮子走出店门，要到麸屋街的汤波半去。

en.t: Chieko carried a large shopping basket out of the shop and set off for Yubahaan on Fuyacho Street.

units.source_text: 从御池大街往上走，一路上，她看见打叡山到北山的天空一片火红，不禁驻足仰望了好一阵子。

en.t: As she walked up from Oike Street, she saw the sky from Mount Hiei to Kitayama glowing bright red, and could not help stopping to look up at it for quite a while.
